Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (Brady Hot Springs PoroTomo DAS, March 2016):

DATA COVERAGE
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20), spanning 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z — 3.314% of the time window.
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc)
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days (net extraction).
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — LBNL catalogue magnitudes):
  b     Sigma     P(M>=5.5)/yr   P(M>=5.5) over observed volume   P(M>=3)/yr
  1.0   -5.449    0.0001198      5.236e-06                        0.03719
  0.73  -5.319    0.004922       0.0002155                        0.2809
  0.65  -5.281    0.01474        0.0006484                        0.4653

UPPER BOUND (DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes; every detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
  b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

INTERPRETATION
- The calibrated probabilities are the catalogue-based (LBNL/NCEDC) values from Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5: even under the lowest b scenario (0.65), P(Mw>=5.5) is only ~1.5% per year (0.065% over the observed 15.96-day volume), so a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event is unlikely to be induced at Brady Hot Springs during this injection period.
- The DAS-based number (P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842, Sigma = -2.698) is an UPPER BOUND with uncalibrated magnitudes: counting all 62 DAS detections as events at or above the catalogue completeness magnitude over-counts, so it is not a calibrated probability and should not be used as one.
- Net fluid volume was negative (extraction exceeded injection by ~4.05e+04 m3), consistent with the low calibrated induced-seismicity probabilities.
